purpose: Teach: キッカケ/曇っ/わるい/じつに/ていねい/いまどき/ことさら/べつに

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、勉強始めたキッカケって何だ?
lines.en: Riku — what got you into studying in the first place?
lines.style: Direct, genuinely curious lean-in. Light challenge underneath the question — testing whether he'll be honest. Warm but sharp.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、空が曇ってきたぞ、傘持ってるか、桜
lines.en: The sky's getting cloudy. You got an umbrella on you, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflection masked as concern. Quiet redirect — not answering, just noticing something practical. Slight distance, like he's side-stepping.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、わるい奴と関わるなよ
lines.en: Don't start hanging around the wrong crowd, okay?
lines.style: Protective warning delivered as matter-of-fact. No lecture, just the steady voice of someone who's watched things go wrong. Firm underneath the casual delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、じつに賢くなったな、桜
lines.en: You've actually gotten really sharp lately, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine observation, slightly surprised at his own admission. Soft, not showy — almost like he's said more than he meant to. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ていねいに答案書けよ
lines.en: Write out your answers neatly on the test, alright?
lines.style: Practical directive with underlying care. Not commanding — more like the advice of someone who knows sloppy handwriting costs points. Steady, grounded tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、いまどきの曲ばっか聞いてんな、桜
lines.en: You've been listening to nothing but current pop songs, haven't you?
lines.style: Wry observation with a hint of affection underneath. Light tease — noticing a small habit with gentle sarcasm. Pace steady, eyebrow-raise implied.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ことさら大声出すなよ
lines.en: Don't make a point of being loud about it, okay?
lines.style: Quiet directive without judgment. Concerned but not nagging — the voice of someone protecting him from something she's seen before. Slightly urgent underneath the calm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストの点、べつに気にすんなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't stress too much about your test scores, alright? They're not the whole story.
lines.style: Reassurance from someone who knows what overthinking feels like. Soft entry, then a gentle firmness. The comfort of being seen and not pitied.
